verdict.rationale: Amplitude's HTTP V2 API for sending events from a server (amplitude-docs-2) and third-party ETL/integration connectors like Fivetran and RudderStack (amplitude-intdir-5, amplitude-intdir-12) suggest a path for importing external or historical event data, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk/batch historical import tool or backfill process. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-import/backfill API documentation, guidance on importing from competitor tools (e.g., Mixpanel/Segment exports), and any hands-on confirmation of successful historical data migration.
